Selected sentry badge and progress treatment

Auto: paired forward chevrons. Hold: pause bars. Empty: hollow slashed magazine, alongside the actual mode. Existing Kenney panel, track, fill and mini-square font are reused. No empty track at idle or cancellation; one continuous left-to-right fill during either operation.

Design mockups over inherited dev captures, not a new executable or proof of runtime badge integration. Ground swatches are crops from those captures. Native 1x and game 2x use the same pixels. Grayscale checks shape and wording, not color alone.
